title: Budget sensitivity
resource_coefficient_fixed_across_budget: required once a coefficient is approved; 0.1/budget is not the proposal
infeasible_budget: report infeasible; do not relax contributor or coverage guards
unconstrained_baseline: may be reported only as an unconstrained reference, not as a matched-budget competitor
grouping: Snapshot related_group_id. Both candidates for a question stay in one group. Groups are not split across partitions.
excluded_records: Unresolved labels, skipped groups, and Development groups sharing History reference context are recorded exclusions. They are not eligible.
final_test_dataset: research_v1_final_test_v2_exploratory_v1 is a separate sealed dataset and is not this eligibility manifest.
history_use: reputation only, after an approved update rule and recorded attempts
dependencies: approved loss, threshold, contributors, and coverage
expected_outputs: one refit policy per approved budget
clean and attacked loss, coverage, and estimated cost
